channel.title: Getting Started :: Go Kure — Launcher
channel.description: Install kurel, build your first package, and explore runnable examples.

item.title: Introduction
item.description: Introduction kurel is an OAM-native package manager for Kubernetes. You describe an application with an OAM-style document (app.yaml) — a set of typed components (webservice, worker, cronjob, postgresql, …) decorated with traits (ingress, certificate, scaler, external-secret, …) — and kurel build resolves it into static, GitOps-ready Kubernetes manifests. The two-config-set model kurel separates what an application needs from how a cluster provides it:

item.title: Install
item.description: Install Release binaries Each release carries kurel for Linux on amd64 and arm64 as kurel_<version>_linux_<arch>.tar.gz, with checksums.txt, a Sigstore bundle signing it (checksums.txt.sigstore.json) and an SBOM per archive. <version> is the tag without its v. The steps below download a release and check that the go-kure release workflow signed its checksums for launcher at that release’s tag. The workflow is shared by every go-kure repository, so the certificate must also name go-kure/launcher and the tag. They then check the archive against the checksums and only then install kurel (into ~/.local/bin; use any directory on your PATH). Each step runs only if the one before it succeeded:

item.title: Examples
item.description: Examples The examples/ directory contains runnable OAM Applications and cluster profiles. Build any of them with: kurel build examples/01-webservice-minimal.yaml \ --profile examples/cluster-profiles/minimal.yaml Application examples Example Shows 01-webservice-minimal / 02-…-with-expose / 03-…-with-tls / 04-…-full webservice from minimal to full (expose, TLS, probes, volumes) 05-worker-minimal / 06-worker-with-traits background workers 07-cronjob-minimal / 08-cronjob-full scheduled jobs 09-postgresql-minimal / 10-postgresql-ha CloudNativePG databases 11-helm Helm chart via Flux 12-daemonset / 13-statefulset node daemons and stateful workloads 14-full-stack a multi-component application 15-passthrough-minimal emit an arbitrary object verbatim Cluster profiles & custom capabilities cluster-profiles/ — platform profiles (minimal, cert-manager + vault, gateway + AWS, …). custom-capability/ — extending kurel with a custom capability. See the Component Handlers, Trait Handlers and Policy Handlers references for the full set of types and their properties.
